simjob.discarded_why: The first driver treated the admissibility band Vc 0.9-1.1 as a hard failure. At Q 0.33 the optimum leaves that band and sits near Vc 1.60, still below 2, so the handbook step stays 0.20. The gate was changed to reject only Vc>=2. The second scope is the record.

law: revert gamma only. Other inputs stay on the endpoint basis. Q is set by factors['Q']=q/0.82, so the solved Q is 0.82 or 0.33. At Vc<2 the handbook step is exactly 0.20.

supported_gamma.compared_with_063_ramp: 063 endpoint ramp is 0.5939 to 0.6042 at Vc 0.9847 to 1.0105, about three times 0.20, and is not admissible

answer.improvement_if_test_returns_0.20: a lighter face at beryllium modulus. R30 ISA closure is 1237.5 kg/m3 at Q 0.82 (specific modulus about 237 MPa per kg/m3, from about 159 at 1850) or 889.3 kg/m3 at Q 0.33 (about 330). PROJECTION, not a qualified safety factor.
answer.T7_still_has_to_show: A closed sandwich shell in this product form, bonded beryllium face on CR-III honeycomb, at Vc 0.9 to 1.1, external pressure, elastic, with measured imperfection amplitude, core ribbon direction and cure recorded, and whether gamma can stand above 0.20. Until that measurement P2 carries 0.20. This card buys nothing.
